Voynich MS - Quire 6

General

For an explanation of the material found on this page, see here.

Description

Quire 6 is a standard quire containing folios 41 through 48. The gathering mark is on f48v.

Schematic folio layout:

Folio 41

Normal folio. The folio nr. is on f41r.

The page has several stains.

Plant drawing with many leaves that have been painted quite summarily in light green. Barely visible unpainted flower near the top.

(none)
